sentences.en: WOMAN: Good morning, oh sorry, it's gone 12, I'll start again, good afternoon, Kingswell Sports Club, how can I help you?
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 下午好，哦，抱歉，已经12点了，我重新开始，下午好，金斯韦尔体育俱乐部，有什么可以帮您的？

sentences.en: Example
sentences.zh: 示例

sentences.en: MAN: Oh, good afternoon.
sentences.zh: MAN: 哦，下午好。

sentences.en: I was wondering if you could give me some information about membership and facilities.
sentences.zh: 我想了解一下会员资格和设施方面的信息。

sentences.en: WOMAN: Of course.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 当然可以。

sentences.en: What would you like to know?
sentences.zh: 您想了解哪些方面？

sentences.en: MAN: Do you have tennis courts, for example?
sentences.zh: MAN: 例如，你们有网球场吗？

sentences.en: WOMAN: No, I'm afraid we don't.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 不好意思，我们没有。

sentences.en: We're primarily a golf club.
sentences.zh: 我们主要是一家高尔夫俱乐部。

sentences.en: MAN: What about football?
sentences.zh: MAN: 那足球呢？

sentences.en: I heard you had a team.
sentences.zh: 我听说你们有一支足球队。

sentences.en: WOMAN: No, I'm sorry.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 不好意思，没有。

sentences.en: Perhaps you'r thinking about Fresham Sports Centre.
sentences.zh: 您可能想到的是弗雷沙姆体育中心。

sentences.en: MAN: Oh, right. 1 know it.
sentences.zh: MAN: 哦，对，我知道那里。

sentences.en: I've played badminton there.
sentences.zh: 我在那儿打过羽毛球。

sentences.en: WOMAN: Have you?
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 是吗？

sentences.en: They've got ä lot of facilitics we don't have and vice versa.
sentences.zh: 他们拥有许多我们没有的设施，反之亦然。

sentences.en: We do have a keep-fit studio, which is very popular with members, and then as well as that there's swimming, of course.
sentences.zh: 我们确实有一个健体工作室，会员们非常喜爱；此外当然还有游泳项目。

sentences.en: MAN: That's good. like to swim every day.
sentences.zh: MAN: 这不错，我喜欢每天游泳。

sentences.en: WOMAN: We have a range of classes too.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 我们还提供多种课程。

sentences.en: MAN: Do you have judo classes?
sentences.zh: MAN: 你们开设柔道课程吗？

sentences.en: I'm keen to learn.
sentences.zh: 我很想学。

sentences.en: WOMAN: Well, at the moment we offer kick-boxing.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 目前我们提供跆拳道课程。

sentences.en: We're planning to add judo and stretch classes soon.
sentences.zh: 我们正计划尽快增设柔道和拉伸课程。

sentences.en: We're currently running a range of yoga classes, too.
sentences.zh: 目前我们也在开展一系列瑜伽课程。

sentences.en: MAN: What about relaxing after exercise?
sentences.zh: MAN: 锻炼之后放松一下呢？

sentences.en: I assume you have a restaurant or something.
sentences.zh: 我猜你们应该有餐厅之类的地方吧？

sentences.en: WOMAN: At the moment, we've got a salad bar which is very popular.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 目前我们设有一个非常受欢迎的沙拉吧。

sentences.en: We'll also have a fully-licensed restaurant by the end of the year.
sentences.zh: 到今年年底，我们还将拥有一家持全牌照的餐厅。

sentences.en: MAN: Sounds good!
sentences.zh: MAN: 听起来不错！

sentences.en: WOMAN: What kind of membership are you interested in?
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 您对哪种类型的会员资格感兴趣？

sentences.en: MAN: Um I'm not really sure.
sentences.zh: MAN: 嗯，我其实不太确定。

sentences.en: What are the options?
sentences.zh: 都有哪些选择？

sentences.en: WOMAN: Well, there are three different membership schemes.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 嗯，我们共有三种不同的会员方案。

sentences.en: MAN: I sec.
sentences.zh: MAN: 我明白了。

sentences.en: What's the difference?
sentences.zh: 它们之间有什么区别？

sentences.en: WOMAN: Well, the first one's called Gold, and you can use all the facilitics at any time of the day or week.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 第一种叫‘黄金会员’，您可以在一天中任何时段或一周中任何时间使用所有设施。

sentences.en: You can also join in as many classes as you like for free.
sentences.zh: 您还可以免费参加任意数量的课程。

sentences.en: MAN: That sounds good.
sentences.zh: MAN: 听起来不错。

sentences.en: Is it very expensive?
sentences.zh: 费用很贵吗？

sentences.en: WOMAN: Well, you pay a £250 joining fee and then it's £450 - oh no, I'm sorry, it's just gone up by £50, sorry about that - it's now £500 for the annual 05 subscription fee.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 好的，您需支付250英镑的入会费，之后是每年450英镑——哦不，抱歉，刚涨了50英镑，不好意思——现在年度会员费为500英镑。

sentences.en: www.TopSage.com Tapescripts †.
sentences.zh: www.TopSage.com 录音稿 †。

sentences.en: SARg
sentences.zh: SARg

sentences.en: MAN: Right, got that.
sentences.zh: MAN: 好的，明白了。

sentences.en: And what's the next type?
sentences.zh: 接下来是哪一类？

sentences.en: WOMAN: Well, that's Silver - it's the same as Gold except you have to pay a dQC.com small fee of £1.00 per lesson for any you do and you can only use the 06 centre at certain times.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 这是银卡会员——与金卡会员基本相同，但您每参加一节课需额外支付1.00英镑的小额费用，且您只能在特定时段使用该中心。

sentences.en: MAN: see.
sentences.zh: MAN: 明白了。

sentences.en: So when exactly?
sentences.zh: 那么具体是什么时候呢？

sentences.en: WOMAN: You can only use the facilities between 10 am and 4.30 pm.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 您只能在上午10点至下午4:30之间使用设施。

sentences.en: MAN: So I couldn't use the pool at 8 in the morning or evening, then?
sentences.zh: MAN: 那么我早上8点或晚上就不能使用游泳池了，对吗？

sentences.en: WOMAN: That's right.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 没错。

sentences.en: MAN: OK.
sentences.zh: MAN: 好的。

sentences.en: And the price for that?
sentences.zh: 那这一类的费用是多少？

sentences.en: Is the joining fee the same as for Gold?
sentences.zh: 入会费和金卡会员一样吗？

sentences.en: WOMAN: Actually, it's slightly less than the £250 - it's £225, but the annual fee is only £300.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 实际上略低于250英镑——是225英镑，但年费仅为300英镑。

sentences.en: Does that sound more like what you want?
sentences.zh: 这听起来更符合您的需求吗？

sentences.en: MAN: Well, it's still rather more expensive than thought.
sentences.zh: MAN: 嗯，这仍比我想的要贵一些。

sentences.en: I'm a student here in England and I'm only here for six months.
sentences.zh: 我是英格兰本地的一名学生，只在这里待六个月。

sentences.en: WOMAN: Ah, then the Bronze scheme would probably suit you best.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 啊，那青铜会员计划可能最适合您。

sentences.en: MAN: How is that different?
sentences.zh: MAN: 这有什么不同？

sentences.en: WOMAN: Well, some of the facilities have restricted use.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 嗯，部分设施的使用受到限制。

sentences.en: MAN: And do I have to pay for classes?
sentences.zh: MAN: 那我需要为课程额外付费吗？

sentences.en: WOMAN: Yes, it's £3 for each class you join.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 是的，您每参加一节课需支付3英镑。

sentences.en: MAN: I see.
sentences.zh: MAN: 明白了。

sentences.en: And what are the hours then?
sentences.zh: 那么开放时间是怎样的？

sentences.en: WOMAN: Between 10.30 and 3.30 weekdays only and you pay a £50 joining fec.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 仅限工作日的上午10:30至下午3:30，且需支付50英镑入会费。

sentences.en: The annual fee is £180 - it works out at £15 a month, so that would be 08 quite a lot cheaper.
sentences.zh: 年费为180英镑——折合每月15英镑，因此会便宜不少。

sentences.en: MAN: Oh, that should be all right. could come in my free periods.
sentences.zh: MAN: 哦，这样应该可以。我可以在我的空闲时段来。

sentences.en: What do I have to do if I want to join?
sentences.zh: 如果我想加入，需要做些什么？

sentences.en: WOMAN: Well, we book you in for an assessment with an instructor, who will show you how to use all the equipment.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 我们会为您预约一次由教练进行的评估，他会向您演示如何使用所有器械。

sentences.en: If you want to organise a trial session and look around the centre, you'll need to speak to David Kynchley.
sentences.zh: 如果您想安排一次试训课并参观中心，您需要联系大卫·金奇利。

sentences.en: MAN: Hmm.
sentences.zh: MAN: 嗯。

sentences.en: Could you spell that please?
sentences.zh: 请问您能拼一下他的名字吗？

sentences.en: WOMAN: Yes, David K-Y-N-C-H-L-E-Y.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 当然可以，大卫，K-Y-N-C-H-L-E-Y。

sentences.en: I'll give you his direct line number.
sentences.zh: 我给您提供他的直拨电话号码。

sentences.en: It's oh-four-five-eight-nine-five-three-doubleone.
MAN: Thanks.
sentences.zh: MAN: 谢谢。

sentences.en: WOMAN: Thank you for calling Kingswell Sports Club.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 感谢致电金斯韦尔体育俱乐部。
